To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
unitiol decreases the toxic effect of dactinycin, but increases the toxic effect of 3 other cytostatics.
unitiol treatment reduced the acute toxicity and hemotoxicity of dactinomyin and increased the acute toxicity of 5-flurorouracil and bleomycetin.
unithiol treatment reduced the acute toxicity of antitumor drugs, dactinomycine and vincristine and potentiated the acute toxicity of 5-flurouracil, vincristine and bleomycetin.

unitiol has a different effect on the acute toxicity of antitumor drugs.

unitiol is not a universal antidote against cytostatic drugs.

unitiol is a universal modifier of the toxicity of cytostatic drugs.
unitiol has a different effect on the acute toxicity of various antitumor drugs.
unitiol is a drug which has a wide range of biological effects.

unitiol is capable of modifying the toxic effect of different cytostatic drugs.
